questions.question: How many national projects were launched on Wildlife Week 2025 with the theme “Human–Wildlife Coexistence”?
questions.solution:
The correct answer is __**Five.**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/7a63139f3b57ffe3814d27f8dcaee8cb420142f7146b480d479d526074519671.png] **__In News__**

__
 
• **The Union Environment Minister Bhupender Yadav launched five new national projects during Wildlife Week 2025 under the theme "Human–Wildlife Coexistence" in Dehradun.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **Key Points__**

__
 
• **The theme for Wildlife Week 2025 was "Human–Wildlife Coexistence," aiming to foster better management of human-wildlife conflicts.**
 
• **Five national conservation projects were launched, including Project Dolphin (Phase II), Project Sloth Bear, and Project Gharial.**
 
• **The event took place at IGNFA, Dehradun, and was organized by the Ministry of Environment, Forest and Climate Change (MoEFCC), in collaboration with institutions like the Wildlife Institute of India (WII), ICFRE, IGNFA, and FRI.**
 
• **In addition to the launch, new estimation and monitoring programs were introduced for species like River Dolphins, Tigers, and Snow Leopards.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

__
 
• Project Dolphin (Phase II)__

 __
 
• Part of India's effort to conserve and protect the endangered species of dolphins, particularly in the rivers of India.
 
 
 
• Project Sloth Bear__
 __
 
• Aimed at conservation of sloth bears and their habitats across India, focusing on research, management, and awareness.
 
 
 
• Project Gharial__
 __
 
• A conservation initiative targeting the gharial species, one of the most critically endangered reptiles in India.
 
 
 
• National Hackathon on Human–Wildlife Conflict Coexistence__
 
 
• A standout feature of the event focusing on innovative solutions to mitigate conflicts between humans and wildlife.

questions.question: Which country holds the top position in the Global Firepower Index 2025 for military strength?

questions.question: Which institution launched the one-year scheme “Facilitating Accelerated Payout – Inoperative Accounts and Unclaimed Deposits” in 2025 to help customers reactivate accounts and claim unclaimed deposits?

options.text: Small Industries Development Bank of India (SIDBI)
Securities and Exchange Board of India (SEBI)

questions.solution:
The correct answer is __**Reserve Bank of India.**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/7a63139f3b57ffe3814d27f8dcaee8cb420142f7146b480d479d526074519671.png] **__In News__**

__
 
• **The Reserve Bank of India launched the scheme “Facilitating Accelerated Payout – Inoperative Accounts and Unclaimed Deposits” on September 30, 2025, with a tenure of one year till September 30, 2026.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **Key Points__**

__
 
• **The scheme encourages the public to activate inactive accounts__ and claim unclaimed deposits.**
 
• **It also directs banks to proactively pursue customers for reactivation and refunds.**
 
• **Aims to reduce the stock of existing unclaimed deposits with the __Depositor Education and Awareness (DEA) Fund__.**
 
• **Also seeks to prevent fresh accretion of unclaimed deposits into the DEA Fund.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

__
 
• **Reserve Bank of India (RBI)**__

 __
 
• Established – 1935 under RBI Act, 1934.
 
• Headquarters – Mumbai, Maharashtra.
 
• Governor – Sanjay Malhotra
 
 
 
• **Depositor Education and Awareness (DEA) Fund**__
 __
 
• Created in 2014 under RBI to manage unclaimed deposits from banks.
 
• Funds are used for depositor education and awareness initiatives.
 
 
 
• **Unclaimed Deposits**__
 __
 
• Balances in savings, current, term deposits, etc., not operated for 10+ years.
 
 
 
• **Objective of the Scheme**__
 
 
• Enhance customer awareness and access to dormant funds.
 
• Strengthen trust in the banking system by reducing inactive deposits.

questions.question: Which state has emerged as the leader in UPI transaction intensity among Indian states, according to a study published by the Reserve Bank of India as per September bulletin?
questions.solution:
The correct answer is __**Telangana.**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/7a63139f3b57ffe3814d27f8dcaee8cb420142f7146b480d479d526074519671.png] **__In News__**

__
 
• Telangana has emerged as the leader in UPI transaction intensity among Indian states, as per a study published in the Reserve Bank of India’s September 2025 bulletin.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **Key Points__**

__
 
• Along with Telangana, states like **Karnataka, Andhra Pradesh, Maharashtra, and Delhi** also reported high per capita UPI usage.
 
• The increase in UPI usage is attributed to factors like urban centers, employment-driven migration, and widespread smartphone and internet penetration.
 
• The study shows a growing dominance of **peer-to-merchant (P2M)** transactions, particularly for daily low-value payments.
 
• There has been a steady decline in cash demand, with UPI transactions now covering a significant portion of daily purchases under ₹500.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

__
 
• **UPI (Unified Payments Interface)**__: A digital payment platform enabling real-time, low-cost transactions across a range of services, especially for daily and small-value purchases.
 
• __**Peer-to-Merchant (P2M) Transactions**__: A major trend showing the growing adoption of UPI for business transactions, helping small vendors and businesses tap into digital payments.
 
• __**Declining Ticket Size**__: The average value of UPI transactions is reducing, reflecting its use for frequent, low-value payments across sectors.
 
• __**PhonePe**__: The main data source used in the study, with PhonePe accounting for 58% of UPI transaction volume and 53% of UPI transaction value.

questions.question: Hindustan Aeronautics Limited (HAL) has signed an MoU with which Russian company for the production of SJ-100 civil commuter aircraft in India?
questions.solution:
The correct answer is __**United Aircraft Corporation.**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/7a63139f3b57ffe3814d27f8dcaee8cb420142f7146b480d479d526074519671.png] **__In News__**

__
 
• **Hindustan Aeronautics Limited (HAL) has signed an MoU with Russia’s United Aircraft Corporation (UAC) for the production of SJ-100 civil commuter aircraft in India, marking a major milestone for indigenous civil aviation manufacturing.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **Key Points__**

__
 
• **The SJ-100 is expected to revolutionize short-haul connectivity under the Government’s UDAN Scheme.**
 
• **This will be the first complete passenger aircraft to be manufactured in India, aligning with the ‘Aatmanirbhar Bharat’ vision.**
 
• **The collaboration is a significant step in building domestic capability in aircraft design and production.**
 
• **Defence Minister Rajnath Singh termed the MoU a game changer for India’s civil aviation sector.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

__
 
• Hindustan Aeronautics Limited (HAL)__

 __
 
• Established: 1940
 
• Headquarters: Bengaluru, Karnataka
 
• A leading aerospace and defence PSU engaged in the design, development, and manufacture of aircraft and helicopters.
 
 
 
• United Aircraft Corporation (UAC)__
 __
 
• Founded: 2006
 
• Headquarters: Moscow, Russia
 
• Parent Organisation: Rostec State Corporation
 
• Specializes in the development and manufacturing of civil and military aircraft including the Sukhoi Superjet (SJ-100).
 
 
 
• UDAN Scheme__
 __
 
• Full Form: Ude Desh ka Aam Naagrik
 
• Launched: 2016
 
• Aims to enhance regional air connectivity and make air travel affordable to common citizens.
 
 
 
• Impact__
 
 
• The SJ-100 project will boost local manufacturing, create job opportunities, and strengthen private participation in aviation.
 
• It represents a major step toward self-reliance in civil aircraft production.

questions.question: What is the aim of the IndiaAI Face Authentication Challenge launched by the Ministry of Electronics and Information Technology?

options.text: To develop a facial authentication system for public exams
To enhance digital governance in India
To create a platform for startup innovations in AI

questions.solution:
The correct answer is __**To develop a facial authentication system for public exams.**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/7a63139f3b57ffe3814d27f8dcaee8cb420142f7146b480d479d526074519671.png] **__In News__**

__
 
• The **IndiaAI Face Authentication Challenge** aims to develop a facial authentication system for fair public exams and reduce fraudulent applications.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **Key Points__**

__
 
• The challenge focuses on developing a scalable AI-powered photo verification system to eliminate identity fraud in public exams.
 
• IndiaAI is offering ₹2.5 crore in prizes, with ₹5 lakh for shortlisted teams and ₹1 crore for the final winners to deploy the solution.
 
• The challenge also emphasizes creating a one-to-many matching system and applying advanced facial recognition algorithms.
 
• The system aims to ensure fairness and transparency in recruitment and examination processes across India.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

• __**Prize Structure**__: The challenge offers funding and contracts for scaling solutions, supporting India’s startup ecosystem and fostering technological innovation.

questions.question: Which three companies are collaborating to build India’s largest AI data hub in Visakhapatnam, with a $15-billion investment?
questions.solution:
The correct answer is __**Google, AdaniConnex, Airtel.**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/7a63139f3b57ffe3814d27f8dcaee8cb420142f7146b480d479d526074519671.png] **__In News__**

__
 
• Google, **AdaniConnex**, and **Airtel** have partnered to build India’s largest AI data hub in Visakhapatnam with a $15-billion investment.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **Key Points__**

__
 
• The data centre will initially have a capacity of **1 gigawatt (GW)**, with plans to scale up to multiple gigawatts.
 
• The project will be supported by **clean energy generation, including solar and storage systems**, along with a new subsea cable gateway.
 
• This initiative is part of Google's global network of AI hubs and will be the largest outside the United States.
 
• The collaboration aims to create a **next-generation digital backbone** for India, accelerating AI innovation and cloud adoption.

• __**AI Data Hub**__: A high-performance data infrastructure supporting AI compute tasks, powered by clean energy sources and robust transmission infrastructure.
 
• __**Subsea Cable Gateway**__: An international cable network supporting faster data transfer between India and global markets, essential for AI and cloud services.
 
• __**Google’s Global AI Hub Network**__: A global network of AI data hubs, with India’s Visakhapatnam hub playing a key role in advancing AI technology in the region.

questions.question: Which major agricultural initiative, launched by the Government of India with an outlay of ₹600 crore, aims to enhance long-staple cotton cultivation, promote High-Density Plantation (HDP) methods, and modernize cotton procurement through the Kapas Kisan App?
questions.solution:
The correct answer is __**Kapas Kranti Mission.**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/7a63139f3b57ffe3814d27f8dcaee8cb420142f7146b480d479d526074519671.png] **__In News__**

__
 
• **The Government of India launched the ₹600 crore Kapas Kranti Mission in Hyderabad to boost long-staple cotton cultivation and improve productivity across major cotton-growing states.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **Key Points__**

__
 
• **The mission promotes High-Density Plantation (HDP) practices, scientific cultivation, and technology-driven procurement models.**
 
• **It aligns with the government’s goal of achieving self-reliance in cotton production and improving income security for farmers.**
 
• **The Kapas Kisan App, launching after Diwali, will help farmers book slots for cotton sales, avoid queues, and ensure fair prices by eliminating middlemen.**
 
• **Telangana farmers will be taken on exposure visits to Maharashtra’s Akola region, which has successfully implemented HDP methods in cotton farming.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

__
 
• **Financial Overview**__

 __
 
• Total Outlay – ₹600 crore
 
• Procurement (2014–2024): 473 lakh bales worth ₹1.37 lakh crore
 
• Telangana and Andhra Pradesh procurement value – ₹65,000 crore
 
• MSP for cotton has doubled in the last decade
 
 
 
• **Procurement Infrastructure**__
 __
 
• 122 procurement centres and 345 ginning centres to be opened post-Diwali
 
• Partnerships with Cotton Corporation of India (CCI)
 
• District-level committees established to prevent farmer exploitation
 
 
 
• **High-Density Plantation (HDP)**__
 __
 
• Proven model from Maharashtra’s Akola region
 
• Uses closer plant spacing, improved seeds, and modern agronomy
 
• Enhances yield and resource efficiency
 
 
 
• **Key Leadership**__
 
 
• Mission announced by – Union Minister G. Kishan Reddy
 
• Implemented by – Ministry of Agriculture & Farmers Welfare, Government of India
 
• Supports – Atmanirbhar Bharat and farmer income doubling vision

questions.question: Which three-billion-US-dollar agreement did the Asian Development Bank (ADB) sign with the World Bank, marking its first-ever EEA with the World Bank and its sixth with other multilateral development banks since 2020?
questions.solution:
The correct answer is __**Sovereign Exposure Exchange Agreement (EEA).**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/7a63139f3b57ffe3814d27f8dcaee8cb420142f7146b480d479d526074519671.png] **__In News__**

__
 
• **The Asian Development Bank (ADB) signed a three-billion-US-dollar Sovereign Exposure Exchange Agreement (EEA) with the World Bank to increase ADB’s lending capacity for developing countries.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **Key Points__**

__
 
• **This agreement is ADB’s first EEA with the World Bank and its sixth such agreement with other multilateral development banks since 2020.**
 
• **The total exchanged amount through these EEAs has reached 9 billion dollars.**
 
• **EEA is a risk management tool designed to reduce portfolio concentration risks, thus increasing lending capacity.**
 
• **Roberta Casali, ADB Vice-President for Finance and Risk Management, highlighted the transformative nature of exposure exchanges in enhancing ADB’s reach and reducing concentration risk.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

__
 
• **Asian Development Bank (ADB)**__

 __
 
• Established in 1966, ADB is a regional development bank aimed at promoting economic and social development in Asia.
 
• Its headquarters are in Manila, Philippines, and it is composed of 68 member countries.
 
 
 
• **World Bank**__
 __
 
• Founded in 1944, the World Bank provides financial and technical assistance to developing countries worldwide.
 
• The bank’s headquarters are in Washington, D.C., USA.
 
 
 
• **Sovereign Exposure Exchange Agreement (EEA)**__
 __
 
• EEA is a financial arrangement where multilateral development banks exchange a portion of their sovereign credit exposure to reduce risks associated with concentration.
 
• It helps in diversifying credit portfolios and enhancing the lending capacity of institutions like ADB.
 
 
 
• **Capital Usage and Lending Capacity**__
 
 
• By reducing exposure concentration through EEAs, ADB optimizes capital usage, thereby increasing its lending capacity.
 
• This tool enables the bank to extend more funds to developing nations for infrastructure and development projects.

questions.question: Who won the Abel Prize in 2025 for contributions to algebraic analysis and representation theory?
questions.solution:
The correct answer is __**Masaki Kashiwara.**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/7a63139f3b57ffe3814d27f8dcaee8cb420142f7146b480d479d526074519671.png] **__In News__**

__
 
• Masaki Kashiwara was awarded the **Abel Prize 2025** for his pioneering work in algebraic analysis and representation theory.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **Key Points__**

__
 
• Kashiwara pioneered the **theory of D-modules**, an algebraic framework for studying linear partial differential equations (PDEs).
 
• He developed key tools like **microsupport** and **characteristic varieties** to study the propagation of singularities in equations.
 
• His work on **sheaf theory** deepened the understanding of the connection between local analytical data and global geometric structure.
 
• The **Abel Prize** is an international award given for outstanding work in mathematics, often considered equivalent to a Nobel Prize for mathematicians.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

__
 
• **Abel Prize**__: A prestigious mathematics award established by the Norwegian Parliament in 2002 and first awarded in 2003, named after Niels Henrik Abel.
 
• __**D-modules**__: Algebraic structures that provide a framework for studying systems of linear partial differential equations.
 
• __**Sheaf theory**__: A branch of mathematics used to study local-global phenomena, often in topology and algebraic geometry.
 
• __**Microsupport**__: A tool in Kashiwara’s work that helps analyze the propagation of singularities in differential equations.

questions.question: Which global event, observed every year on 20 October, aims to raise awareness about osteoporosis and metabolic bone disease, with the theme for 2025 being "It’s Unacceptable!"?
questions.solution:
The correct answer is __**World Osteoporosis Day.**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/7a63139f3b57ffe3814d27f8dcaee8cb420142f7146b480d479d526074519671.png] **__In News__**

__
 
• **World Osteoporosis Day is observed globally every year on 20 October to raise awareness about osteoporosis and metabolic bone disease.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **Key Points__**

__
 
• **The theme for World Osteoporosis Day 2025 is “It’s Unacceptable!”**
 
• **The day was first observed on 20 October 1996, initiated by the United Kingdom's National Osteoporosis Society in collaboration with the European Commission.**
 
• **In 1997, the International Osteoporosis Foundation (IOF) took over the organization of World Osteoporosis Day.**
 
• **The World Health Organization (WHO) co-sponsored the event in 1998 and 1999, promoting awareness of osteoporosis globally.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

__
 
• **Osteoporosis**__

 __
 
• A condition where bones become weak and brittle, increasing the risk of fractures.
 
• It is often called the "silent disease" as it progresses without symptoms until a fracture occurs.
 
 
 
• **World Health Organization (WHO)**__
 __
 
• WHO is a specialized agency of the United Nations responsible for international public health.
 
• It has supported World Osteoporosis Day in its early years to raise global awareness.
 
 
 
• **International Osteoporosis Foundation (IOF)**__
 __
 
• Founded in 1997, the IOF is dedicated to the prevention, diagnosis, and treatment of osteoporosis and related bone diseases.
 
 
 
• **Previous Themes of World Osteoporosis Day**__
 
 
• 1999: "Early Detection" was the first theme to raise awareness about the importance of early diagnosis.
 
• Each year, World Osteoporosis Day adopts a specific theme to highlight different aspects of osteoporosis awareness and prevention.

questions.question: What new authentication methods for UPI transactions were unveiled at the Global Fintech Fest 2025?
questions.solution:
The correct answer is __**Biometric and Wearable Glass-based Authentication.**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/7a63139f3b57ffe3814d27f8dcaee8cb420142f7146b480d479d526074519671.png] **__In News__**

__
 
• **The National Payments Corporation of India (NPCI), in collaboration with the Reserve Bank of India (RBI), unveiled biometric and wearable glass-based authentication for UPI transactions at the Global Fintech Fest 2025.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **Key Points__**

__
 
• **The new system allows users to authenticate UPI payments using facial recognition or fingerprints linked to their Aadhaar, potentially replacing the traditional UPI PIN.**
 
• **The introduction of biometric and wearable glass-based authentication aims to enhance security, ease of use, and financial inclusion, especially benefiting senior citizens and rural populations.**
 
• **Wearable Glass Payments enable users to complete small-value transactions with a voice command and quick QR scan without the need for a phone, PIN, or touch.**
 
• **NPCI’s latest upgrade also includes multi-signatory accounts for joint account holders, improving transparency and convenience.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

__
 
• Biometric Authentication__

 __
 
• A method of authenticating payments through fingerprint or facial recognition linked to Aadhaar, offering enhanced security and privacy.
 
 
 
• Wearable Glass Payments__
 __
 
• New feature that allows hands-free payments through wearable smart glasses, enabling quick transactions with voice commands and QR scans.
 
 
 
• Multi-Signatory Accounts__
 __
 
• Allows joint account holders to require multiple approvals for transactions, offering added security and convenience.
 
 
 
• UPI Lite__

questions.question: By how much did the overall positive conservation outlook drop according to the IUCN World Heritage Outlook 4 report?
questions.solution:
The correct answer is __**5%.**__

__
 
• The overall positive conservation outlook dropped from **62% in 2020** to **57% in 2025**, according to the IUCN World Heritage Outlook 4 report.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **Key Points__**

__
 
• The report revealed that **climate change** is now the greatest threat to natural World Heritage sites, affecting 43% of them.
 
• Invasive alien species affect **30%** of sites, and wildlife and plant diseases have increased from **2% in 2020 to 9%** in 2025.
 
• **Sundarbans National Park** has deteriorated from "Good with Some Concerns" to "Significant Concern" due to sea-level rise, salinity, and cyclones.
 
• **Manas National Park** continues to be in significant concern due to **poaching and encroachment**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

__
 
• **IUCN World Heritage Outlook 4**__: A report that assesses the conservation outlook of natural World Heritage sites globally, identifying threats like climate change, invasive species, and diseases.
 
• __**Climate change threats**__: Global warming and its impacts, such as rising sea levels, extreme weather events, and temperature shifts, threatening the ecosystems of World Heritage sites.
 
• __**Positive conservation outlook**__: The percentage of World Heritage sites assessed as being in good or stable conservation status, which has decreased over the years.
 
• __**Sundarbans National Park**__: A UNESCO World Heritage site that faces significant threats from rising sea levels and increasing salinity due to climate change.

questions.question: What is the theme for United Nations (UN) Day 2025, marking the 80th anniversary of the UN Charter's entry into force?
questions.solution:

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/7a63139f3b57ffe3814d27f8dcaee8cb420142f7146b480d479d526074519671.png] **__In News__**

• **United Nations (UN) Day 2025 celebrates the 80th anniversary of the UN Charter's entry into force in 1945.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **Key Points__**

__
 
• The theme for the 80th anniversary is “Building our future together,” highlighting global collaboration for a sustainable and peaceful future.
 
• **The “Our Common Agenda” report guides the initiatives for the 80th anniversary, advocating stronger global governance.**
 
• **The report emphasizes the urgent need for accelerating the implementation of Sustainable Development Goals (SDGs).**
 
• **UN Day 2025 serves as a call to action for global cooperation in addressing common challenges and building a sustainable future.**
 
• **This year’s celebration marks the UN’s role in fostering peace, security, human rights, and development across the globe.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 __

 __

questions.question: Which Sikh festival, coinciding with Diwali, commemorates the release of Guru Hargobind Sahib Ji and 52 Rajput princes from Gwalior Fort in 1619, symbolizing freedom, justice, and selfless leadership?
questions.solution:
The correct answer is __**Bandi Chhor Divas.**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/7a63139f3b57ffe3814d27f8dcaee8cb420142f7146b480d479d526074519671.png] **__In News__**

__
 
• **On October 21, 2025, Sikhs across the world celebrate Bandi Chhor Divas — the “Day of Liberation” — marking Guru Hargobind Sahib Ji’s release from Gwalior Fort along with 52 Rajput princes in 1619.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **Key Points__**

__
 
• **Bandi Chhor Divas coincides with Diwali but carries distinct spiritual meaning rooted in liberation, justice, and selflessness.**
 
• **Guru Hargobind Sahib Ji, the sixth Sikh Guru, was imprisoned in Gwalior Fort by Mughal Emperor Jahangir along with 52 Hindu princes.**
 
• **He refused to leave until all the princes were freed; he had a robe made with 52 tassels so each could hold on as they walked to freedom.**
 
• **When he returned to Amritsar, the city was lit up in celebration, establishing the tradition of lighting lamps at the Golden Temple on this day.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

__
 
• **Historical Context**__

 __
 
• Year of the event – 1619, during the reign of Mughal Emperor Jahangir.
 
• Guru Hargobind Sahib Ji’s release is seen as a triumph of moral courage and collective freedom.
 
 
 
• **Celebrations**__
 __
 
• Gurdwaras are decorated with diyas, candles, and lights.
 
• Shabad kirtan (devotional singing), ardas (prayers), and langar (community meals) are organized globally.
 
• The Golden Temple in Amritsar glows with thousands of lamps and fireworks.
 
 
 
• **Symbolic Meaning**__
 __
 
• Represents collective liberation — freedom that uplifts everyone, not just oneself.
 
• Embodies Sikh principles of Miri-Piri (temporal and spiritual balance) and seva (selfless service).
 
 
 
• **Modern Relevance**__
 
 
• Bandi Chhor Divas encourages reflection on compassion, leadership, and justice in today’s world.
 
• It highlights that true freedom includes standing up for the rights of others.

questions.question: Which state in India has become the first to be officially declared “free of extreme poverty” by its Chief Minister on November 1, 2025?
questions.solution:
The correct answer is __**Kerala.**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/7a63139f3b57ffe3814d27f8dcaee8cb420142f7146b480d479d526074519671.png] **__In News__**

__
 
• **Kerala has become the first state in India to be officially declared "free of extreme poverty," with the announcement on November 1, 2025, by Chief Minister Pinarayi Vijayan.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **Key Points__**

__
 
• **The announcement comes after Kerala’s successful extreme poverty eradication programme, launched in 2021, which aimed to uplift families living in severe economic distress.**
 
• **The programme focused on integrating local resources for housing, food, health, and income support to ensure long-term rehabilitation for the poor.**
 
• **Kerala’s success in eliminating extreme poverty is attributed to its investments in human development, such as high literacy rates, universal healthcare, and decentralized governance.**
 
• **Kerala's achievement aligns with India's Sustainable Development Goal (SDG) 1 — ending poverty in all its forms and sets a model for other states to follow.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

__
 
• **Extreme Poverty Definition**__

 __
 
• Households lacking access to basic income, shelter, food, and health.
 
• Excluded from social welfare schemes due to lack of documentation or isolation.
 
• Often stuck in multi-generational poverty with minimal upward mobility.
 
 
 
• **Why Kerala Leads in Social Development**__
 __
 
• High literacy rates and access to universal healthcare.
 
• Empowered panchayats and strong local governance systems.
 
• Proactive civil society and effective implementation of welfare schemes.
 
 
 
• **National and Policy Significance**__
 __
 
• Kerala’s achievement serves as a model for other states in poverty alleviation.
 
• It aligns with India’s commitment to SDG 1, contributing to global poverty reduction goals.
 
• It emphasizes the need for updated national poverty data and multi-dimensional poverty measurement.
 
 
 
• **Next Steps for Kerala**__
 
 
• Continue monitoring vulnerable households to prevent relapse into poverty.
 
• Focus on skill development and job-linking programs for long-term sustainability.
 
• Strengthen safety nets and support for marginalized communities.

questions.question: The 2025 Nobel Prize in Physiology or Medicine was awarded for the discoveries concerning _______________________________.

options.text: Peripheral immune tolerance and regulatory T cells
Understanding of IPEX syndrome in gene therapy
The role of central tolerance in the thymus

questions.solution:
The correct answer is __**Peripheral immune tolerance and regulatory T cells.**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/7a63139f3b57ffe3814d27f8dcaee8cb420142f7146b480d479d526074519671.png] **__In News__**

__
 
• **The 2025 Nobel Prize in Physiology or Medicine was awarded for discoveries concerning peripheral immune tolerance and regulatory T cells (Tregs).**

 
 
• Shimon Sakaguchi's 1995 discovery revealed regulatory T cells (Tregs) as key players in immune tolerance, challenging previous beliefs.
 
• Mary E. Brunkow and Fred Ramsdell's 2001 discovery of the FOXP3 gene was pivotal in understanding Treg function and its link to autoimmune diseases like IPEX syndrome.
 
• The work has significantly advanced our understanding of autoimmune diseases, cancer immunotherapy, and organ transplant success.
 
• Treg dysfunction can lead to autoimmune diseases, while excessive Treg activity can suppress the immune response against tumors in cancer.
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **Key Points__** 

__
 
• The*** 2025 Nobel Prizes ***were awarded across five categories, highlighting achievements in quantum physics, materials science, immunology, literature, and peace.

 
 
• **Physics Prize:**

 
 
• Awarded to** John Clarke, Michel H. Devoret, and John M. Martinis** for their work in **macroscopic quantum mechanical tunneling and energy quantization in electric circuits**, showcasing quantum mechanics at a macroscopic scale.
 
• Their work enabled advances in quantum computing, cryptography, and quantum sensors.
 
 
 
• **Chemistry Prize:**
 
 
• Awarded to** Susumu Kitagawa, Richard Robson, and Omar M. Yaghi** for their development of **metal-organic frameworks (MOFs), materials with vast internal surface areas** for various applications such as water harvesting, carbon capture, and toxic gas storage.
 
 
 
• **Literature Prize:**
 
 
• Awarded to L**ászló Krasznahorkai **for his** visionary works, including "Satantango**", which explore themes of apocalyptic terror, chaos, and human isolation.
 
• Known for long, complex sentences and dark, philosophical narratives.
 
 
 
• **Peace Prize:**
 
 
• Awarded to **Maria Corina Machado**, a** Venezuelan leader **and symbol of democratic resistance against authoritarianism in Venezuela, emphasizing "ballots over bullets" and leading the opposition.
 
• Praised for her courage despite life-threatening risks and for unifying the opposition around democratic principles.
 
 
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Geographical Distribution:**

 
 
• United States leads with six laureates.
 
• Other countries: Japan (2 laureates), Australia, Hungary, and Venezuela (1 laureate each).
 
 
 
• **Ceremony:** 
 
 
• The award ceremony will take place on December 10, 2025, in Stockholm (Peace Prize in Oslo).
 
• Each prize includes 11 million Swedish kronor, a gold medal, and a diploma.
